spec.mechanism: A zero-beta, long-volatility intraday overlay (G1: trend continuation after a move beyond the day's noise band, flat overnight) earns most when a long-only core loses (2018, 2020, 2022); adding it to a volatility-managed index core (Moreira & Muir 2017) at equal notional raises the portfolio's Sharpe ratio and does not deepen its drawdown, which leverage alone would not do.
